title: Zealot's Oath
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Zealot's Oath}}

'''Zealot's Oath''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that applies [[life regeneration]] to [[energy shield]] instead of [[life]].

==Mechanics==
Percentage and flat life regeneration becomes percentage and flat ES regeneration, including from outside sources such as allied [[Consecrated Ground]]. Percentage ES regeneration is based on maximum ES.<ref>{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=January 23, 2013|title=Zealot's Oath|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/69777/page/4#p864682|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=March 8, 2013}}</ref> This is not a [[conversion]] mechanic. ES regeneration gained through Zealot's Oath will only scale with ES Recovery Rate, not Life Recovery Rate or Life Regeneration Rate.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794</ref> 

Non-regeneration forms of life [[recovery]] such as [[recoup]], [[leech]], or [[life flask]]s are unaffected by Zealot's Oath.<ref>{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=January 29, 2013|title=Zealot's Oath is bugged (either the skill or the description)|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/81592#p926402|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=March 14, 2013}}</ref>

Zealot's Oath causes the user to no longer have life regen, which causes effects that interact specifically with life regeneration amount, such as {{psl|Pious Path}} and {{il|Kaom's Spirit}}, to not work with Zealot's Oath.<ref name="Pious Path Interaction">{{cite web
| author = Community_Team
| date = May 27, 2021
| title = Game Mechanics Q&A Answer Part 2
| url = https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3130696
| publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums
| accessdate = May 29, 2021
}}</ref>

Zealot's Oath is a standalone keystone located in the northwest side of the tree, close to the [[Templar]]'s area.
